BiblicalUsage: Rannen is shouting for joy — the cry of the redeemed. God says of Zion, 'I will also clothe her priests with salvation: and her saints shall shout aloud for joy.'
TheologicalSignificance: What I see here is that the shout is the end of the psalm: priests clothed with salvation, and saints who cannot keep quiet about it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
